<!--
  This Behavior Tree replans the global path periodically at 1 Hz through an array of poses continuously
   and it also has recovery actions specific to planning / control as well as general system issues.
-->
<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="6" name="NavigateRecovery">
      <PipelineSequence name="NavigateWithReplanning">
        <RateController hz="0.333">
          <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="1" name="ComputePathThroughPoses">
            <ReactiveSequence>
              <RemovePassedGoals input_goals="{goals}" output_goals="{goals}" radius="0.5"/>
              <ComputePathThroughPoses goals="{goals}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased"/>
            </ReactiveSequence>
            <ReactiveFallback name="ComputePathThroughPosesRecoveryFallback">
              <GoalUpdated/>
              <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Context" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
            </ReactiveFallback>
          </RecoveryNode>
        </RateController>
        <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="1" name="FollowPath">
          <FollowPath path="{path}" controller_id="FollowPath"/>
          <ReactiveFallback name="FollowPathRecoveryFallback">
            <GoalUpdated/>
            <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Context" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
          </ReactiveFallback>
        </RecoveryNode>
      </PipelineSequence>
      <ReactiveFallback name="RecoveryFallback">
        <GoalUpdated/>
        <RoundRobin name="RecoveryActions">
          <Sequence name="ClearingActions">
            <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
            <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
          </Sequence>
          <Spin spin_dist="1.57"/>
          <Wait wait_duration="5"/>
          <BackUp backup_dist="0.15" backup_speed="0.025"/>
        </RoundRobin>
      </ReactiveFallback>
    </RecoveryNode>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>
mrq:
The mission describes continuous navigation through an array of poses with periodic path replanning and layered recovery actions.

The root RecoveryNode NavigateRecovery will execute the main navigation subtree. If the main navigation subtree fails, it will execute the recovery subtree and retry navigation until the six available retries are exhausted.

First, the PipelineSequence NavigateWithReplanning will execute its child actions in order and stop if any action fails. It will advance to the next action while the current action is running or has succeeded.

Next, the RateController will limit execution of the ComputePathThroughPoses recovery subtree to 0.333 Hz. The RecoveryNode ComputePathThroughPoses will execute its main path-planning subtree. If that subtree fails, it will execute its recovery fallback and retry path planning once.

Next, the ReactiveSequence will execute RemovePassedGoals and ComputePathThroughPoses in sequence. If ComputePathThroughPoses is running, it will re-evaluate RemovePassedGoals. If either action fails, it will stop the sequence.

Next, the custom action RemovePassedGoals will remove goals within the specified radius from the input goal list. It will read the input goals from the blackboard and store the updated goals under the same blackboard key.

Next, the ROS action ComputePathThroughPoses will calculate a path through the current goals. It will store the calculated path on the blackboard.

Next, the ReactiveFallback ComputePathThroughPosesRecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then ClearEntireCostmap consecutively until one action succeeds. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate earlier actions. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop the fallback.

Next, the custom action GoalUpdated will check whether the navigation goal has changed. The custom action ClearEntireCostmap will clear the global costmap when goal updating does not succeed.

Next, the RecoveryNode FollowPath will execute the main path-following action. If path following fails, it will execute its recovery fallback and retry path following once.

Next, the ROS action FollowPath will follow the path stored on the blackboard. It will use the specified path-following controller.

Next, the ReactiveFallback FollowPathRecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then ClearEntireCostmap consecutively until one action succeeds. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate earlier actions. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop the fallback.

Next, the custom action ClearEntireCostmap will clear the local costmap when goal updating does not succeed.

Finally, the ReactiveFallback RecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then RecoveryActions consecutively until one action succeeds. While RecoveryActions is running, it will re-evaluate GoalUpdated. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will halt RecoveryActions.

Next, the RoundRobin RecoveryActions will execute its recovery actions in rotation. It will run ClearingActions, Spin, Wait, and BackUp as recovery alternatives.

Next, the Sequence ClearingActions will execute the two costmap-clearing actions in order and stop if either action fails. The custom action ClearEntireCostmap will clear the local costmap. The custom action ClearEntireCostmap will then clear the global costmap.

Next, the custom action Spin will rotate the robot by the specified distance. The custom action Wait will pause execution for the specified duration. The custom action BackUp will move the robot backward by the specified distance at the specified speed.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathThroughPoses will use planner_id="GridBased", read goals from {goals}, and store the path under {path}. The custom action RemovePassedGoals will read input_goals from {goals}, store output_goals under {goals}, and use radius="0.5". The ROS action FollowPath will read path from {path} and use controller_id="FollowPath". The custom action Spin will use spin_dist="1.57". The custom action Wait will use wait_duration="5". The custom action BackUp will use backup_dist="0.15" and backup_speed="0.025".

The mission describes continuous navigation to a goal with periodic path replanning and layered recovery actions.

First, the root RecoveryNode NavigateRecovery will execute the main navigation subtree. If the main subtree fails, it will execute recovery actions and retry the main subtree until six retries are exhausted. If recovery fails after the retries are exhausted, it will stop execution.

Next, the PipelineSequence NavigateWithReplanning will execute the RateController and the FollowPath recovery subtree in order. It will stop if an action fails. While an action is running or has succeeded, it will proceed to the next action.

Next, the RateController will run the ComputePathToPose recovery subtree at a rate of 1.0 Hz.

Next, the RecoveryNode ComputePathToPose will execute the ROS action ComputePathToPose. If it fails, it will execute the ComputePathToPoseRecoveryFallback recovery action and then retry the ROS action. If recovery fails after one retry, it will stop execution.

Next, the ReactiveFallback ComputePathToPoseRecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then ClearGlobalCostmap-Context in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. If GoalUpdated fails, it will execute ClearGlobalCostmap-Context. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate previous actions. If a previous action succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop the fallback.

Next, the RecoveryNode FollowPath will execute the ROS action FollowPath. If it fails, it will execute the FollowPathRecoveryFallback recovery action and then retry the ROS action. If recovery fails after one retry, it will stop execution.

Next, the ReactiveFallback FollowPathRecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then ClearLocalCostmap-Context in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. If GoalUpdated fails, it will execute ClearLocalCostmap-Context. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate previous actions. If a previous action succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop the fallback.

Next, the ReactiveFallback RecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then RecoveryActions in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. If GoalUpdated fails, it will execute RecoveryActions. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate previous actions. If a previous action succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop the fallback.

Next, the RoundRobin RecoveryActions will execute ClearingActions, Spin, Wait, and BackUp as recovery actions in rotation.

Next, the Sequence ClearingActions will execute ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree and ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree in order. It will stop the sequence if either action fails.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathToPose will receive goal from {goal}, store its path under {path}, and use planner_id GridBased. The ROS action ClearGlobalCostmap-Context will use service_name global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap. The ROS action FollowPath will receive path from {path} and use controller_id FollowPath. The ROS action ClearLocalCostmap-Context will use service_name local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap. The ROS action ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree will use service_name local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap. The ROS action ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree will use service_name global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap. The ROS action Spin will use spin_dist 1.57. The ROS action Wait will use wait_duration 5. The ROS action BackUp will use backup_dist 0.15 and backup_speed 0.025.

<!--
  This Behavior Tree replans the global path periodically at 1 Hz and it also has
  recovery actions.
-->
<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="2" name="NavigateRecovery">
      <PipelineSequence name="NavigateWithReplanning">
        <RateController hz="1.0">
          <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="4" name="ComputePathToPose">
            <ComputePathToPose goal="{goal}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased"/>
            <ReactiveFallback name="PathToPoseFallback">
              <GoalUpdated/>
              <RoundRobin name="GlobalPlannerRecoveryActions">
                <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Context" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
                <Wait wait_duration="2"/>
              </RoundRobin>
            </ReactiveFallback>
          </RecoveryNode>
        </RateController>
        <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="4" name="FollowPath">
          <FollowPath path="{path}" controller_id="FollowPath"/>
          <ReactiveFallback name="FollowPathFallback">
            <GoalUpdated/>
            <RoundRobin name="PlannerRecoveryActions">
              <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Context" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
              <Spin spin_dist="1.57"/>
            </RoundRobin>
          </ReactiveFallback>
        </RecoveryNode>
      </PipelineSequence>
      <ReactiveFallback name="RecoveryFallback">
        <GoalUpdated/>
        <Wait wait_duration="5"/>
      </ReactiveFallback>
    </RecoveryNode>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>
mrq:
The mission describes navigating to a goal while periodically replanning the global path and applying recovery actions when path computation or path following fails.

First, the root recovery node will execute the main navigation sequence. If the main navigation sequence fails, it will execute the recovery fallback and retry the main navigation sequence until two recovery attempts are exhausted.

Next, the pipeline sequence NavigateWithReplanning will execute RateController and FollowPath in order and stop if an action fails. While RateController is running or has succeeded, it will proceed to FollowPath.

Next, the rate controller will execute the ComputePathToPose recovery node at a frequency of 1.0 Hz.

Next, the ComputePathToPose recovery node will execute the ROS action ComputePathToPose. If it fails, it will execute PathToPoseFallback and retry the ROS action ComputePathToPose until four recovery attempts are exhausted.

Next, the reactive fallback PathToPoseFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then GlobalPlannerRecoveryActions in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. Otherwise, it will continue executing and re-evaluating GoalUpdated while a later action is running.

Next, the round-robin recovery action GlobalPlannerRecoveryActions will execute ClearGlobalCostmap-Context and Wait in rotation.

Next, the recovery node FollowPath will execute the ROS action FollowPath. If it fails, it will execute FollowPathFallback and retry the ROS action FollowPath until four recovery attempts are exhausted.

Next, the reactive fallback FollowPathFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then PlannerRecoveryActions in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. Otherwise, it will continue executing and re-evaluating GoalUpdated while a later action is running.

Next, the round-robin recovery action PlannerRecoveryActions will execute ClearLocalCostmap-Context and Spin in rotation.

Finally, the recovery fallback RecoveryFallback will execute GoalUpdated and then Wait consecutively. If GoalUpdated fails, it will execute Wait.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathToPose will use goal="{goal}", path="{path}", and planner_id="GridBased". The rate controller will use hz="1.0". The recovery node NavigateRecovery will use number_of_retries="2". The recovery node ComputePathToPose will use number_of_retries="4". ClearGlobalCostmap-Context will use service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap". Wait in GlobalPlannerRecoveryActions will use wait_duration="2". The recovery node FollowPath will use number_of_retries="4". The ROS action FollowPath will use path="{path}" and controller_id="FollowPath". ClearLocalCostmap-Context will use service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap". Spin will use spin_dist="1.57". Wait in RecoveryFallback will use wait_duration="5".

The mission describes navigating to a goal while recomputing the global path at 1 Hz.

First, it will execute the PipelineSequence NavigateWithReplanning actions (RateController, FollowPath) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. While an action is running or has succeeded, it will go to the next action.

Next, it will execute the ROS action ComputePathToPose after each 1-second rate-control interval. It will store the computed path in the path blackboard key. It will use the goal blackboard key and the GridBased planner.

Finally, it will execute the ROS action FollowPath using the stored path and the FollowPath controller.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathToPose will receive goal={goal}, path={path}, and planner_id=GridBased. The ROS action FollowPath will receive path={path} and controller_id=FollowPath.

The mission describes the TestNav behavior tree, which opens the gripper, navigates the vehicle, searches for an object, picks it up, places it in an available carry area, and returns to the drive position.

First, the root main_sequence will execute MoveGripper, NavigateVehicle, and main_manipulator_sequence in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

Next, main_manipulator_sequence will execute find_object and handle_object in order and stop the sequence if either subtree fails.

Next, find_object will execute its child actions consecutively. If force_failure11 fails, it will move to search_frame3. If search_frame3 succeeds, it will stop the fallback. If search_frame3 fails, it will move to force_failure1. If no child succeeds, the fallback will fail.

Next, force_failure11 will execute search1 and make sure it always fails.

Next, search1 will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, search_frame3 will execute search2 and ObjectSearch in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, search2 will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, force_failure1 will execute gotodrive and make sure it always fails.

Next, gotodrive will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, handle_object will execute handle_not_able_to_close and leave_object in order and stop the sequence if either subtree fails.

Next, handle_not_able_to_close will execute pick_object and then use movetodrive as a fallback if pick_object fails. If pick_object fails, it will move to movetodrive. If both alternatives fail, the fallback will fail.

Next, pick_object will execute main_move_to_object and MoveGripper in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, main_move_to_object will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, force_failure1 will execute movetodrive and make sure it always fails.

Next, movetodrive will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, leave_object will execute find_empty_frame, emptyframe, MoveGripper, and drive in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

Next, find_empty_frame will use check_empty_frame first. If check_empty_frame fails, it will execute force_failure2. If either alternative succeeds, the fallback will succeed. If both alternatives fail, the fallback will fail.

Next, check_empty_frame will check carryarea1, carryarea2, and carryarea3 consecutively until one EmptyFrame action succeeds. If all three actions fail, the fallback will fail.

Next, force_failure2 will execute MoveGripper and make sure it always fails.

Next, emptyframe will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Next, drive will execute PlanManipulatorPath and MoveManipulator in order and stop the sequence if either action fails.

Parameters: MoveGripper will use action="open" for the first gripper action. NavigateVehicle will use no ports. PlanManipulatorPath will use plan_to_frame="search2", manipulator_path="{manipulator_path}", and move_to_frame="{move_to_frame}". MoveManipulator will use path="{manipulator_path}" and move_to_frame="{move_to_frame}". ObjectSearch will store its result under "{object_pose}". PlanManipulatorPath will use plan_to_frame="object", object_pose="{object_pose}", manipulator_path="{manipulator_path}", and move_to_frame="{move_to_frame}". MoveGripper will use action="close". EmptyFrame will use check_frame="carryarea1" and store its result under "{empty_frame}". EmptyFrame will use check_frame="carryarea2" and store its result under "{empty_frame}". EmptyFrame will use check_frame="carryarea3" and store its result under "{empty_frame}". PlanManipulatorPath will use plan_to_frame="{empty_frame}", manipulator_path="{manipulator_path}", and move_to_frame="{move_to_frame}". MoveGripper will use action="open". PlanManipulatorPath will use plan_to_frame="driveposition", manipulator_path="{manipulator_path}", and move_to_frame="{move_to_frame}".

mrq:
The mission describes a grasp-generation task that segments a tabletop scene, conditionally extracts and clusters a desired object, and generates grasping candidates.

First, the root sequence will execute the following actions in order and stop if any action fails: RetryUntilSuccesful, ConditionalSequence, and GenerateGraspingCandidates.

Next, the RetryUntilSuccesful node will keep trying to execute TableTopSegmentation until it succeeds. It will make up to three attempts. The robot will run the custom action TableTopSegmentation to segment the tabletop scene.

Then, the ConditionalSequence node will execute its actions in order while checking the condition for each action. If the condition is true, it will move to the next action. If the condition is false, it will end the sequence. The BlackboardEntryCheck decorator will check the desired object entry before running ObjectCloudExtraction. It will execute ObjectCloudExtraction only when the entry check succeeds. It will then execute TableTopClustering if ObjectCloudExtraction succeeds.

Finally, GenerateGraspingCandidates will generate grasp candidates after the preceding actions succeed. It will run the custom action GenerateGraspingCandidates using the extracted object cloud and table height.

Parameters: TableTopSegmentation will read {original_cloud}, {image_scene}, and {table_height}, and will store results under {original_cloud_transformed}, {tabletop_cloud}, {plane_cloud}, and {nonplane_cloud}. ObjectCloudExtraction will read {original_cloud}, {image_scene}, {tabletop_cloud}, and {desired_object}, and will store the result under {object_cloud}. TableTopClustering will read {object_cloud} and {tabletop_cloud}. GenerateGraspingCandidates will read {object_cloud}, {table_height}, and {original_cloud_transformed}, and will store results under {grasp_candidates}.

mrq:
The mission describes a staged movement task that waits, repeatedly attempts to reach a named goal, and then waits again.

First, the root sequence will execute the actions (Stage1WaitSeconds1, ForceSuccess, WaitSeconds) in order and will stop if any action fails.

Next, the ROS action Stage1WaitSeconds1 will wait for 2 seconds.

Then, the ForceSuccess decorator will execute the Repeat action and will make sure it always succeeds. The Repeat decorator will execute Stage1GoToGoal 10 times. The custom action Stage1GoToGoal will direct the robot to the goal named stage_1_pos_final_5 through the action server /Make_Plan.

Finally, the ROS action WaitSeconds will wait for 3 seconds.

Parameters: Stage1WaitSeconds1 will use duration 2. Stage1GoToGoal will use goal_name stage_1_pos_final_5 and action /Make_Plan. The Repeat decorator will use num_cycles 10. WaitSeconds will use duration 3.

First, the root sequence will execute the following actions (Nav2ClearGlobalCostMap, RobotSeekInitAction, KeepRunningUntilFailure) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

Next, it will run custom action Nav2ClearGlobalCostMap.

Then, it will run custom action RobotSeekInitAction using the configured search poses.

Finally, the KeepRunningUntilFailure node will execute its child sequence. If the child sequence succeeds, it will restart it. If the child sequence fails, it will stop looping and continue execution.

First, the child sequence will execute the following actions (RobotSeekNextSearchPose, MoveRobot, TextToSpeechActionClient, the inner sequence) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

Next, it will run custom action RobotSeekNextSearchPose, which will select the next search pose and provide the next goal and speech message.

Then, it will execute the MoveRobot subtree. The MoveRobot sequence named SetGoal will execute Nav2Client and stop if that action fails. It will run ROS action Nav2Client using the selected next goal.

Afterward, it will run custom action TextToSpeechActionClient to announce the selected goal speech.

Finally, the inner sequence will execute the fallback node.

First, the fallback node will execute its child sequences consecutively. If the first child sequence fails, it will move to the second child sequence. If the second child sequence fails, the fallback will fail.

Next, the first fallback child sequence will execute the ReactiveSequence and the speech action in order. It will stop if either action fails.

Then, the ReactiveSequence will execute the following actions (Inverter, RobotSpin) in sequence. If the Inverter fails, it will stop execution. While RobotSpin is running, it will re-evaluate the Inverter. If the Inverter then fails, it will halt RobotSpin and stop the sequence.

The Inverter will execute inverted HumanPoseDetect. If HumanPoseDetect succeeds, the Inverter will return failure. If HumanPoseDetect fails, the Inverter will return success.

HumanPoseDetect will check for a person using the presence setting and will provide detected-person and speech-result values.

If the inverted detection succeeds, it will run custom action RobotSpin and rotate 340 degrees at a velocity of 0.5.

After the reactive sequence fails, the first fallback child sequence will run custom action TextToSpeechActionClient to say, “I didn't see anyone.”

If the first fallback child sequence does not succeed, the second fallback child sequence will execute HumanPoseDetect followed by TextToSpeechActionClient in order.

It will run custom action HumanPoseDetect to check for a person using the presence setting.

If HumanPoseDetect succeeds, it will run custom action TextToSpeechActionClient to say, “Hi there! I found you!”

Parameters: Nav2Client will read the goal from {target}. RobotSeekNextSearchPose will store the selected goal under {next_goal} and the selected speech under {goal_speech}. HumanPoseDetect will read pose_lr_check as "presence", expected_pose_left as an empty value, and expected_pose_right as an empty value, and it will store detection status under {detected_person}, left-pose speech under {pose_left_speech}, and right-pose speech under {pose_right_speech}. <!--
  This Behavior Tree first computes a path using the global planner (ComputePathToPose).
  Then, it runs two sub-branches in parallel. The first sub-branch is a FollowPath
  operation (the local planner). In parallel, there is a rate controlled execution of
  FollowPath (the global planner). Each time a new path is computed, the path update
  is sent to the local planner. The right branch, which is the rate controlled
  ComputePathToPose, always returns RUNNING. Because the Parallel node uses a
  threshold of 1, whenever the FollowPath returns SUCCESS or FAILURE, the parallel
  node will return this result.

  The goal (input to the global planner) and the resulting path (output of the global
  planner and input to the local planner) are passed on the blackboard.

  The rate at which the ComputePathToPose operation is invoked can be controlled with
  the hz parameter to the RateController node.
-->

<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <SequenceStar name="root">
      <ComputePathToPose goal="${goal}" path="${path}"/>
      <ParallelNode threshold="1">
        <FollowPath path="${path}"/>
        <Sequence>
          <RateController hz="1.0">
            <ComputePathToPose goal="${goal}" path="${path}"/>
          </RateController>
          <UpdatePath/>
        </Sequence>
      </ParallelNode>
    </SequenceStar>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>

First, the root ReactiveSequence will execute CheckStop, CheckBattery, CheckDiagnosticStatus, CheckPatientCondition, and the inner Sequence in order. If any action fails, it will stop execution. <!--
  This Behavior Tree replans the global path periodically at 1 Hz and it also has
  recovery actions.
-->
<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="6" name="NavigateRecovery">
      <PipelineSequence name="NavigateWithReplanning">
        <RateController hz="1.0">
          <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="1" name="ComputePathToPose">
            <ComputePathToPose goal="{goal}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased"/>
            <ClearEntireCostmap service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
          </RecoveryNode>
        </RateController>
        <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="1" name="FollowPath">
          <FollowPath path="{path}" controller_id="FollowPath"/>
          <ClearEntireCostmap service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
        </RecoveryNode>
      </PipelineSequence>
      <SequenceStar name="RecoveryActions">
        <ClearEntireCostmap service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
        <ClearEntireCostmap service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
        <Spin spin_dist="1.57"/>
        <Wait wait_duration="5"/>
      </SequenceStar>
    </RecoveryNode>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>
mrq:
The mission describes navigating to a goal while periodically replanning the global path and using recovery actions when navigation fails.

First, the root recovery node NavigateRecovery will execute the main navigation subtree. If the main navigation subtree fails, it will execute the recovery actions and retry the main navigation subtree until six retries are exhausted. If the recovery actions fail and retries are exhausted, it will stop execution.

Next, the PipelineSequence NavigateWithReplanning will execute RateController and FollowPath in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. While an action is running or has succeeded, it will move to the next action.

Then, the ROS action RateController will execute the nested recovery node ComputePathToPose at a rate of 1.0 Hz.

Next, the recovery node ComputePathToPose will execute the ROS action ComputePathToPose. If it fails, it will execute the ROS action ClearEntireCostmap and retry the ROS action ComputePathToPose once. If the recovery action fails and the retry is exhausted, it will stop execution.

Then, the ROS action ComputePathToPose will compute a path to the goal and store the path.

Next, the ROS action FollowPath will execute the nested recovery node FollowPath using the stored path.

Then, the recovery node FollowPath will execute the ROS action FollowPath. If it fails, it will execute the ROS action ClearEntireCostmap and retry the ROS action FollowPath once. If the recovery action fails and the retry is exhausted, it will stop execution.

Next, the ROS action FollowPath will follow the stored path using the FollowPath controller.

Finally, the SequenceStar RecoveryActions will execute the following actions in sequence: ClearEntireCostmap, ClearEntireCostmap, Spin, and Wait. If any action succeeds, it will remember it and move to the next. If any action fails, it will restart the sequence from the failed action.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathToPose will use goal={goal}, path={path}, and planner_id=GridBased. The ROS action RateController will use hz=1.0. The ROS action FollowPath will use path={path} and controller_id=FollowPath. The ROS action ClearEntireCostmap will use service_name=local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap. The ROS action ClearEntireCostmap will use service_name=global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap. The ROS action Spin will use spin_dist=1.57. The ROS action Wait will use wait_duration=5.

First, the root Repeat node will execute the fallback Pursue Goals indefinitely.

Next, the fallback Pursue Goals will execute the sequences Place Item and Remove Item consecutively. If any sequence fails, it will move to the next sequence until one succeeds. If no sequence succeeds, the fallback will fail.

Then, the sequence Place Item will execute the HoldingItem condition and the Place action in order. It will stop if either child fails. The HoldingItem condition will check whether the robot is holding an item. If the condition succeeds, it will run the Place action to place the item.

Finally, the sequence Remove Item will execute the SeeItem condition and the Pick action in order. It will stop if either child fails. The SeeItem condition will check whether it sees an item. If the condition succeeds, it will run the Pick action to pick up the item.

mrq:
The mission describes initializing the robot and repeatedly attempting to pursue goals by placing a held item or picking up a visible item.

First, the root sequence will execute the actions (Init, RetryUntilSuccesful) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails.

Next, the Init subtree will execute the custom action Print.

Then, the RetryUntilSuccesful node will keep trying to execute the Fallback named Pursue Goals until it succeeds. If an attempt succeeds, it will stop retrying. If an attempt fails, it will keep retrying indefinitely.

Then, the Fallback named Pursue Goals will execute the actions (ForceFailure named No Item to Place, ForceFailure named No Item to Pick) consecutively. If the ForceFailure named No Item to Place action fails, it will move to the ForceFailure named No Item to Pick action. If no action succeeds, the execution will fail.

Next, the ForceFailure named No Item to Place node will execute the Sequence named Place Item and make sure it always fails.

Then, the Sequence named Place Item will execute the actions (Holding an Item, Place it) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will check whether the robot is holding an item. If the check succeeds, it will execute the custom action Place.

Next, the ForceFailure named No Item to Pick node will execute the Sequence named Remove Item and make sure it always fails.

Then, the Sequence named Remove Item will execute the actions (See an Item, Pick it up) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will check whether it can see an item. If the check succeeds, it will execute the custom action Pick.

Parameters: The custom action Print will use message "Initialize".

The mission describes a parallel task that continuously records a variant while locating a wooden box, navigating to fixed coordinates, and dropping the object.

First, the robot will execute the following actions (the Repeat node and the Sequence node) simultaneously. If one action succeeds, the parallel execution will succeed. If one action fails, the parallel execution will fail.

Next, it will execute the VariantAction continuously until it fails or succeeds. Else it will keep executing VariantAction forever.

Then, it will execute the following actions (objectplacement, the GoTo sequence, and objectdrop) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will run custom action objectplacement using the query WOODENBOX_0.1_0.3_0.3_0.3. It will execute the GoTo sequence with x_input set to 1.61 and y_input set to 7.76. It will run custom action objectdrop using object index -1.

Next, it will execute the following actions (pathPlanner, CheckPositiveCondition, and the Repeat node) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will run custom action pathPlanner using x coordinate 1.61 and y coordinate 7.76, store the waypoint count under {number_of_waypoints_}, and store the waypoints under {waypoints_}. It will check whether the value {number_of_waypoints_} matches the condition value {number_of_waypoints_}. It will execute the waypoint sequence {number_of_waypoints_} times.

Finally, it will execute the following actions (the inner Sequence) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will run custom action ExecutePathAction using {waypoints_}, store the current waypoint x coordinate under {_w_x}, and store the current waypoint y coordinate under {_w_y}. It will run custom action moveRoboterPosition using approach radius 100 and the stored waypoint coordinates.

Parameters: VariantAction will use value {variant}. objectplacement will use query WOODENBOX_0.1_0.3_0.3_0.3. GoTo will use x_input 1.61 and y_input 7.76. objectdrop will use obj_index -1. pathPlanner will use x 1.61 and y 7.76 and will store number_of_waypoints under {number_of_waypoints_} and waypoints under {waypoints_}. CheckPositiveCondition will use value {number_of_waypoints_}. ExecutePathAction will use waypoints {waypoints_} and will store w_x under {_w_x} and w_y under {_w_y}. moveRoboterPosition will use approachRadius 100, x {_w_x}, and y {_w_y}.

The mission describes a job-execution task that retrieves a job and repeatedly selects the matching job procedure until one succeeds.

First, the root will execute the Jobs subtree.

Next, the Jobs sequence will execute GetJob and the FallbackStar named by its position. If GetJob succeeds, the fallback will try JobButcherAnimal, JobDyeAnimal, JobLeadAnimalToPasture, JobHarvestAnimal, JobTameAnimal, JobHaulMultiple, and JobStandard in order. If a job subtree fails, it will try the next subtree. If all job subtrees fail, it will restart from JobButcherAnimal until one succeeds.

Next, the JobButcherAnimal precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches ButcherAnimal. If the check passes, its fallback will try the butchering sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitAnimalJob, Move, GrabAnimal, GetItemDropPosition, Move, FinalMoveAnimal, ButcherAnimal, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the JobDyeAnimal precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches DyeAnimal. If the check passes, its fallback will try the dyeing sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitJob, ClaimItems, MoveAllItemsToJob, InitAnimalJob, Move, GrabAnimal, GetItemDropPosition, Move, FinalMoveAnimal, DyeAnimal, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the JobLeadAnimalToPasture precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches LeadAnimalToPasture. If the check passes, its fallback will try the leading sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitAnimalJob, Move, GrabAnimal, GetItemDropPosition, Move, FinalMoveAnimal, ReleaseAnimal, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the JobHarvestAnimal precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches HarvestAnimal. If the check passes, its fallback will try the harvesting sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitAnimalJob, Move, GrabAnimal, HarvestAnimal, ReleaseAnimal, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the JobTameAnimal precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches TameAnimal. If the check passes, its fallback will try the taming sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitAnimalJob, Move, TameAnimal, GrabAnimal, GetItemDropPosition, Move, FinalMoveAnimal, ReleaseAnimal, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the JobHaulMultiple precondition will check whether the blackboard value under {JobType} matches HauleMultipleItems. If the check passes, its fallback will try the hauling sequence and then AbortJob if that sequence fails. The sequence will execute InitJob, FindTool, Move, EquipTool, the inverted item-pickup sequence, AllPickedUp, GetItemDropPosition, Move, DropAllItems, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the inverted item-pickup sequence will invert the result of its inner sequence. The inner sequence will invert AllPickedUp, execute Move and PickUpItem, and execute ReturnAlwaysRunning. If AllPickedUp is false, the inner inverter will succeed. If the inner pickup sequence succeeds, the outer inverter will fail. If the inner pickup sequence fails, the outer inverter will succeed.

Next, the JobStandard fallback will try the StandardJobs sequence and then AbortJob if the sequence fails. The StandardJobs sequence will execute InitJob, ClaimItems, FindTool, Move, EquipTool, MoveAllItemsToJob, GetWorkPosition, Move, Work, and FinishJob in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the MoveAllItemsToJob sequence will invert its item-moving loop and then check AllItemsInPlaceForJob. The inverted item-moving loop will invert a sequence that checks the negation of AllItemsInPlaceForJob, executes the item-moving sequence, and executes ReturnAlwaysRunning. The item-moving sequence will execute Move, PickUpItem, GetItemDropPosition, Move, and DropItem in sequence. If AllItemsInPlaceForJob is false, the inner inverter will succeed. If the item-moving sequence succeeds, the outer inverter will fail. If the item-moving sequence fails, the outer inverter will succeed. After the inverted loop succeeds, the sequence will require AllItemsInPlaceForJob to be true.

Next, the GetUniform sequence will execute CheckUniform, the fallback, and EquipUniform in order. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action. The fallback will try Move and then UniformCleanUp if Move fails.

Next, the Hunger sequence will check IsHungry before executing its nested sequence. If IsHungry is true, it will execute the Hunger sequence and then check IsFull. The Hunger sequence will execute FindFood, Move, PickUpItem, the forced-success dining sequence, and Eat in order. The forced-success dining sequence will execute FindDining and Move and will always succeed. If IsHungry is false, the outer sequence will stop.

Next, the Thirst sequence will check IsThirsty before executing its nested sequence. If IsThirsty is true, it will execute the Thirst sequence and then check IsDrinkFull. The Thirst sequence will execute FindDrink, Move, PickUpItem, the forced-success dining sequence, and Drink in order. The forced-success dining sequence will execute FindDining and Move and will always succeed. If IsThirsty is false, the outer sequence will stop.

Next, the Sleep sequence will check IsSleepy before executing the forced-success movement sequence and Sleep. The forced-success movement sequence will execute FindBed and Move and will always succeed. If IsSleepy is false, the sequence will stop.

Next, the Trainer sequence will check IsTrainer before executing FindTrainerPosition, Move, and SuperviseTraining in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the Training sequence will check IsTrainingTime before executing FindTrainingGround, Move, and Train in sequence. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action.

Next, the Combat sequence will check IsInCombat before executing AbortJob, the forced-success combat sequence, and a final IsInCombat check. If an action succeeds, it will remember that action and move to the next action. If an action fails, it will restart from the failed action. The forced-success combat sequence will execute GetTarget, Move, and the adjacent-target sequence and will always succeed. The adjacent-target sequence will check TargetAdjacent before executing AttackTarget. If TargetAdjacent is false, the adjacent-target sequence will stop.

The BB_Precondition for JobLeadAnimalToPasture will compare {JobType} with LeadAnimalToPasture. The BB_Precondition for JobHarvestAnimal will compare {JobType} with HarvestAnimal. The BB_Precondition for JobTameAnimal will compare {JobType} with TameAnimal. The BB_Precondition for JobHaulMultiple will compare {JobType} with HauleMultipleItems.

<!--
  This Behavior Tree first goes into a branch where it will check if the robot is stuck.
  If that is the case, it will attempt to recover. Otherwise it will continue with
  the navigation branch. In this case the navigation branch is based on `simple_sequential.xml`.
-->

<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="root">
      <FallbackStar name="check_motion">
        <Inverter name="is_not_stuck">
          <IsStuck/>
        </Inverter>
        <SequenceStar name="stuck_recovery">
          <Stop/>
          <BackUp/>
          <Spin/>
        </SequenceStar>
      </FallbackStar>
      <SequenceStar name="navigate">
        <ComputePathToPose endpoints="${endpoints}" path="${path}"/>
        <FollowPath path="${path}"/>
      </SequenceStar>
    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>

The mission describes a navigation task that checks for a stuck condition, performs recovery when necessary, and then follows a computed path.

First, the root sequence will execute check_motion and navigate in order and will stop if either subtree fails.

Next, the check_motion fallback star will execute its children consecutively. If an attempted child fails, it will move to the next child until one succeeds. If all children fail, it will restart from the beginning until one succeeds. The inverted is_not_stuck decorator will execute IsStuck with its result reversed. If IsStuck succeeds, the decorator will fail. If IsStuck fails, the decorator will succeed. The robot will check whether it is not stuck. The stuck_recovery sequence star will execute Stop, BackUp, and Spin in order while remembering successful actions. If an action fails, it will restart from that failed action. It will stop the robot, back it up, and spin it.

Finally, the navigate sequence star will execute ComputePathToPose and FollowPath in order while remembering successful actions. If an action fails, it will restart from that failed action. It will compute a path using the provided endpoints and then follow the computed path.

Parameters: The ROS action ComputePathToPose will use endpoints from {endpoints} and store the resulting path under {path}. The ROS action FollowPath will use the path from {path}.

            <ComputePathToPose goal="{goal}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased"/>
          <!--  <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Context" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>-->
            <!--<Wait wait_duration="3"/>-->
            <SequenceStar name="ResetGlobalPath">
              <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>
              <Wait wait_duration="1"/>
            </SequenceStar>
          </RecoveryNode>
        </RateController>
        <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="1" name="FollowPath">

          <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Context" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>

  Then, it runs two sub-branches in parallel. The first sub-branch is a FollowPath

  FollowPath (the global planner). Each time a new path is computed, the path update

  ComputePathToPose, always returns RUNNING. Because the Parallel node uses a
  threshold of 1, whenever the FollowPath returns SUCCESS or FAILURE, the parallel
  node will return this result.

  planner and input to the local planner) are passed on the blackboard.

  The rate at which the ComputePathToPose operation is invoked can be controlled with
  the hz parameter to the RateController node.
-->

          <GoalReached/>
          <ComputePathToPose goal="${goal}"/>
        </Fallback>
      </RateController>
      <FollowPath path="${path}"/>
    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Next, the Autonomous sequence will execute ReachRoom, BottleFound, and Fetch in order and will stop if any child fails.

Next, the ReachRoom fallback will execute ShouldFollow and will execute FollowHuman if ShouldFollow fails.

Next, the ShouldFollow sequence will check RoomKnown and GoToRoom_Fal in order and will stop if either child fails.

Next, the GoToRoom_Fal fallback will check RobotInRoom and will execute GoToRoom if RobotInRoom fails.

Next, the BottleFound fallback will check BottleFound and will execute FindBottle if the condition fails.

Next, the Fetch fallback will check BottleGrasped and will execute Grasp if the condition fails.

Next, the Grasp sequence will execute InvPoseCompute, GoInvPose, Locate, and GraspBottle in order and will stop if any child fails.

Next, the InvPoseCompute fallback will execute SeqInvPose and will execute ComputeInvPose if SeqInvPose fails.

Next, the GoInvPose fallback will check RobotAtInvPose and will execute prepare if the condition fails.

Next, the prepare sequence will execute KeepArmsForGrasp and GoToInvPose in order and will stop if either action fails.

Next, the Locate fallback will check BottleLocated and will execute LocateBottle if the condition fails.

Next, the robot will execute GraspBottle after the inverse pose is computed or validated, the robot reaches the inverse pose, and the bottle is located.

Next, the Fetch fallback will execute SetInvPoseInvaild and KeepRunning if its Grasp branch fails.

The mission describes a robot operation that releases a left suction cup when necessary, performs score-based movement and arm actions, updates and displays the score, and then tests sensor states.

First, the root sequence will execute the reactive suction-control subtree followed by the forced-success operation subtree in order and will stop if either child fails.

Next, the reactive fallback will execute the reactive sequence first and will use the suction-release action if that sequence fails or remains unsuccessful.

The reactive sequence will execute the inverted left-suction condition followed by the waiting action in order and will re-evaluate the inverted condition while the waiting action is running.

The inverter will execute the left-suction condition with reversed results.

The inverted condition will succeed when IsVentouseGauche is false.

The waiting action will run for 3000 milliseconds after the inverted condition succeeds.

The fallback will execute the Pince action with all valves closed if the reactive sequence does not succeed.

Next, the ForceSuccess decorator will execute its sequence and will always report success.

The sequence will execute the first forced-success sequence, the second forced-success sequence, two arm actions, the forced-success score-update sequence, the score-display action, and the TestSensors subtree in order and will stop internally if an unforced action fails.

The first ForceSuccess decorator will execute its suction-position sequence and will always report success.

The suction-position sequence will check IsVentouseGauche, open the left valve, check IsVentouseCentre, open the middle valve, check IsVentouseDroite, and open the right valve in order.

The Pince action will open the left valve while keeping the middle and right valves closed after IsVentouseGauche succeeds.

The Pince action will open the middle valve while keeping the left and right valves closed after IsVentouseCentre succeeds.

The Pince action will open the right valve while keeping the left and middle valves closed after IsVentouseDroite succeeds.

The second ForceSuccess decorator will execute its score-based movement sequence and will always report success.

The score-based sequence will check whether the score is below 2, set the score to 5, move forward, wait, rotate, wait, stop, start a five-second timer, and move to the specified position in order.

The DefinirLeScore action will set the score to 5 when ScoreInferieurA with score 2 is true.

The waiting action will run for 1000 milliseconds after the forward movement.

The VitesseConstante action will rotate at 1 radian per second with zero linear velocity.

The waiting action will run for 1000 milliseconds after the rotation.

          <FollowPath path="{path}" controller_id="FollowPath"/>
          <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Context" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
        </RecoveryNode>
      </PipelineSequence>
      <ReactiveFallback name="RecoveryFallback">
        <GoalUpdated/>
        <SequenceStar name="RecoveryActions">
          <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree" service_name="local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap"/>
          <ClearEntireCostmap name="ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree" service_name="global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap"/>

mrq:
The mission describes navigating to a goal while periodically replanning the global path and using recovery actions when navigation fails.

First, it will execute main NavigateWithReplanning. If it fails, it will execute recovery action RecoveryFallback. After recovery, it will retry main action NavigateWithReplanning. If recovery action RecoveryFallback fails and retries are exhausted, it will stop execution.

Next, it will execute the following actions (RateController, FollowPath) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. While an action is running or has succeeded, it will go to the next action.

Next, it will execute delayed ComputePathToPose after the delay timer. After each one-second delay period is exhausted, it will resume execution.

Next, it will execute main ComputePathToPose. If it fails, it will execute recovery action ClearGlobalCostmap-Context. After recovery, it will retry main action ComputePathToPose. If recovery action ClearGlobalCostmap-Context fails and retries are exhausted, it will stop execution.

Next, it will execute main FollowPath. If it fails, it will execute recovery action ClearLocalCostmap-Context. After recovery, it will retry main action FollowPath. If recovery action ClearLocalCostmap-Context fails and retries are exhausted, it will stop execution.

Finally, it will execute the following actions (GoalUpdated, RecoveryActions) in order. If GoalUpdated succeeds, it will stop execution. Otherwise, it will keep executing and re-evaluating previous actions whenever an action is running. If GoalUpdated then succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop the fallback.

Next, it will execute the following actions (ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree, ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree, Spin, Wait) in sequence. If any action succeeds, it will remember it and move to the next. If any action fails, it will start the sequence again from the failed action.

The ROS action ClearGlobalCostmap-Context will use service_name global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap. The ROS action FollowPath will use path from {path} and controller_id FollowPath. The ROS action ClearLocalCostmap-Context will use service_name local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap. The ROS action ClearLocalCostmap-Subtree will use service_name local_costmap/clear_entirely_local_costmap. The ROS action ClearGlobalCostmap-Subtree will use service_name global_costmap/clear_entirely_global_costmap. The ROS action Spin will use spin_dist 1.57.                         <SubTree ID="KillRemainingNodes" __shared_blackboard="false" parameter_set="parameter_set"/>
                    </Sequence>
                </Fallback>
            </IfThenElse>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <!-- ////////// -->
    <BehaviorTree ID="KillRemainingNodes">
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
            <Sequence>
                <Action ID="SetKillGroups" curr_kill_group="{curr_group}" parameter_set="{parameter_set}"/>
                <ForceSuccess>
                    <Sequence>
                        <Action ID="KillNodeFromGroup" group="{curr_group}" kill_node="{curr_node}"/>
                        <Action ID="KillROSNode" node="{curr_node}"/>
                    </Sequence>
                </ForceSuccess>
            </Sequence>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
    </BehaviorTree>

            <SubTree ID="ProcessStatus" __shared_blackboard="false" desc="desc" err="err" key="key" status="status"/>
            <Fallback name="ErrorType">
                <Sequence>

                    <SubTree ID="RTABMapHandling" __shared_blackboard="false" key="key" rtabmap_strike="rtabmap_strike" status="status"/>

                <Sequence>
                    <Condition ID="MoveBaseMonitor" description="{desc}"/>
                    <SetBlackboard output_key="key" value="/move_base"/>
                    <SubTree ID="RestartNode" __shared_blackboard="false" blocked_groups="blocked_groups" desc="desc" key="key" status="status"/>
                </Sequence>
                <Sequence>
                    <Condition ID="NodeMonitor" description="{desc}"/>
                    <SubTree ID="RestartNode" __shared_blackboard="false" blocked_groups="blocked_groups" desc="desc" key="key" status="status"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
        </Sequence>

    <BehaviorTree ID="ProcessStatus">
        <Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <Condition ID="StatusInfo" description="{desc}" error_level="{err}" key="{key}"/>
                <Action ID="StatusToParamServer" description="{desc}" key="{key}" rewrite_stamp="true"/>
                <SetBlackboard output_key="status" value="INFO"/>
                <Action ID="ROSOut" level="INFO" msg="Everything ok!" throttle_period="120"/>

                <SetBlackboard output_key="status" value="WARN"/>

                <SetBlackboard output_key="status" value="ERROR"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <!-- ////////// -->
    <BehaviorTree ID="RTABMapHandling">
        <Fallback>
            <BlackboardCheckString return_on_mismatch="FAILURE" value_A="INFO" value_B="{status}">
                <SetBlackboard name="ResetStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="0"/>
            </BlackboardCheckString>
            <BlackboardCheckString return_on_mismatch="FAILURE" value_A="ERROR" value_B="{status}">
                <Switch4 case_1="0" case_2="1" case_3="2" case_4="3" name="SwitchStrikeCase" variable="{rtabmap_strike}">
                    <Sequence>
                        <Action ID="RotateToRelocalize"/>
                        <Action ID="SaveTimestamp" timestamp="{timestamp}"/>
                        <SetBlackboard name="SetFirstStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="1"/>
                    </Sequence>
                    <ForceSuccess>
                        <Sequence>
                            <Fallback>
                                <Condition ID="TimePassed" duration="60" timestamp="{timestamp}"/>
                                <ForceFailure>
                                    <Action ID="RotateToRelocalize"/>
                                </ForceFailure>
                            </Fallback>
                            <ForceSuccess>

                                        <Action ID="KillROSNode" node="{kill_node}"/>
                                    </Sequence>

                            <Action ID="SaveTimestamp" timestamp="{timestamp}"/>
                            <SetBlackboard name="SetSecondStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="2"/>
                        </Sequence>
                    </ForceSuccess>
                    <Sequence>
                        <Action ID="RotateToRelocalize"/>
                        <Action ID="SaveTimestamp" timestamp="{timestamp}"/>
                        <SetBlackboard name="SetThirdStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="3"/>
                    </Sequence>
                    <Sequence>
                        <Fallback>

                            <ForceFailure>

                        <IfThenElse name="IfSuccesfulReset">

                            <SetBlackboard name="ResetStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="0"/>
                            <SetBlackboard name="SetFourthStrike" output_key="rtabmap_strike" value="0"/>
                        </IfThenElse>
                    </Sequence>
                    <AlwaysSuccess/>
                </Switch4>
            </BlackboardCheckString>
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <!-- ////////// -->
    <BehaviorTree ID="RestartNode">

                        <Action ID="StartLaunchFile" blocked_groups="{blocked_groups}" group_block="{group}" launch_file="{launch_file}" pkg="{pkg}"/>
                        <Delay delay_msec="500">
                            <AlwaysSuccess/>
                        </Delay>
                        <Action ID="ROSOut" level="INFO" msg="Launch file started" throttle_period="0"/>
                    </Sequence>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
        </BlackboardCheckString>
    </BehaviorTree>

mrq:
The mission describes continuous monitoring of robot systems, including monitoring configuration, status processing, RTAB-Map recovery, and monitored-node restarting.

First, the root Sequence will execute ConfigureMonitoring, Monitoring, ProcessStatus, and ErrorType in order and will stop if any child fails.

Next, ConfigureMonitoring will execute its Fallback and use the first successful branch. It will check whether monitoring is already reconfigured. If monitoring is not reconfigured, it will reset the parameter set to NOT_SET and reset the RTAB-Map strike count to 0. It will then evaluate whether the robot is charging. If it is charging, it will check whether {parameter_set} matches CHARGING. If the values do not match, it will reconfigure monitoring for CHARGING and store the result in {parameter_set}. It will speak “Gute Nacht!” and display the SLEEP facial expression for 100000 seconds while forcing that sequence to succeed. It will then execute KillRemainingNodes with the parameter set. If it is not charging, it will check whether {parameter_set} matches OPERATING. If the values do not match, it will reconfigure monitoring for OPERATING and store the result in {parameter_set}. It will speak “Guten Morgen!” and display the NEUTRAL facial expression for 5.0 seconds while forcing that sequence to succeed. It will then execute KillRemainingNodes with the parameter set.

Then, KillRemainingNodes will repeatedly execute its sequence until the sequence fails. It will select the current kill group from {parameter_set} and store it in {curr_group}. It will select a node from {curr_group} and store it in {curr_node}. It will execute the node-killing actions while forcing their sequence to succeed. It will remove the selected node from its group and kill the corresponding ROS node.

Next, the Monitoring sequence will execute ConfigureMonitoring, the Monitoring action, ProcessStatus, and ErrorType in order. The Monitoring action will inspect monitored systems using {blocked_groups} and store the description in {desc}, the error level in {err}, and the monitored key in {key}. ProcessStatus will classify the reported status. ErrorType will select the first matching error-handling branch.

Next, ProcessStatus will execute its Fallback and will use the first successful status branch. If StatusInfo is true for {desc}, {err}, and {key}, it will write the status to the parameter server with timestamp rewriting enabled. It will store INFO in {status} and publish “Everything ok!” at INFO level with a throttle period of 120 seconds. If StatusInfo is false and StatusWarn is true for the same inputs, it will write the status to the parameter server with timestamp rewriting enabled and store WARN in {status}. If both earlier checks are false and StatusError is true, it will write the status to the parameter server with timestamp rewriting disabled and store ERROR in {status}.

Next, ErrorType will execute its branches consecutively until one succeeds. If RTABMapMonitor is true for {desc}, it will execute RTABMapHandling with {key}, {rtabmap_strike}, and {status}. If RTABMapMonitor is false and MoveBaseMonitor is true for {desc}, it will store /move_base in {key} and execute RestartNode with {blocked_groups}, {desc}, {key}, and {status}. If the earlier checks are false and NodeMonitor is true for {desc}, it will execute RestartNode with the same remapped values.

Next, RTABMapHandling will execute its Fallback and will use the first successful branch. If {status} matches INFO, it will reset {rtabmap_strike} to 0. If {status} does not match INFO but matches ERROR, it will select a response based on {rtabmap_strike}. For strike 0, it will rotate to relocalize, save a timestamp in {timestamp}, and set {rtabmap_strike} to 1. For strike 1, it will check whether 60 seconds have passed since {timestamp}. If 60 seconds have not passed, it will force the relocalization action to fail. If 60 seconds have passed, it will continue. It will set {key} to /rtabmap/rtabmap, derive {group} from {key}, select a node into {kill_node}, and kill that ROS node. It will then set {key} to /move_base, derive {group} from {key}, select a node into {kill_node}, and kill that ROS node. It will save a new timestamp in {timestamp} and set {rtabmap_strike} to 2. For strike 2, it will rotate to relocalize, save a timestamp in {timestamp}, and set {rtabmap_strike} to 3. For strike 3, it will check whether 60 seconds have passed since {timestamp}. If 60 seconds have not passed, it will force the relocalization action to fail. If 60 seconds have passed, it will read the localization_lost parameter into {localization_msg}. If CallSupervisor succeeds with {localization_msg}, it will reset {rtabmap_strike} to 0. If CallSupervisor fails, it will set {rtabmap_strike} to 0. If no strike case matches, it will execute an always-successful action.

Next, RestartNode will check whether {status} matches ERROR. If the status does not match ERROR, it will stop. If the status matches ERROR, it will derive {group} from {key}. It will check whether {group} is not blocked. If the group is blocked, it will publish “Group still blocked. Restart process skipped.” at INFO level. It will then try the kill sequence before the launch sequence. The kill sequence will select a node from {group} into {kill_node} and kill that ROS node. If the kill sequence fails, it will derive {launch_file} and {pkg} from {group}. It will start the launch file while updating {blocked_groups}, using {group} as the group block. It will wait 500 milliseconds and publish “Launch file started” at INFO level.

Parameters: The ROS action ReconfigureMonitoring will use parameter_set="CHARGING" or parameter_set="OPERATING" and will store its result in {parameter_set}. The ROS action Speak will use text="Gute Nacht!" or text="Guten Morgen!". The ROS action FacialExpression will use duration="100000" or duration="5.0" and expression="SLEEP" or expression="NEUTRAL". The ROS action SetKillGroups will use parameter_set={parameter_set} and store the group in {curr_group}. The ROS action KillNodeFromGroup will use group={curr_group} or group={group} and store the selected node in {curr_node} or {kill_node}. The ROS action KillROSNode will use node={curr_node} or node={kill_node}. The ROS action Monitoring will use blocked_groups={blocked_groups} and store description in {desc}, error level in {err}, and key in {key}. The ROS action StatusToParamServer will use description={desc}, key={key}, and rewrite_stamp="true" or "false". The ROS action ROSOut will use level="INFO", msg="Everything ok!" or msg="Group still blocked. Restart process skipped." or msg="Launch file started", and throttle_period="120" or "0". The ROS action RotateToRelocalize will use no ports. The ROS action SaveTimestamp will store its result in {timestamp}. The ROS action GroupFromKey will use key={key} and store the group in {group}. The ROS action ROSParamToBlackboard will use param="localization_lost" and store the result in {localization_msg}. The ROS action CallSupervisor will use message={localization_msg}. The ROS action LaunchFileFromGroup will use group={group} and store results in {launch_file} and {pkg}. The ROS action StartLaunchFile will use blocked_groups={blocked_groups}, group_block={group}, launch_file={launch_file}, and pkg={pkg}.

The mission describes a peg insertion task that checks insertion progress, performs search motion when needed, traverses to a configured position, and otherwise applies a default motion goal.

First, the root reactive fallback will execute root_sequence, 2-traverse, and the final mg_config in order. If root_sequence succeeds, it will stop. Otherwise, it will continue to 2-traverse and then to the final mg_config. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate earlier actions. If an earlier action succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop the fallback.

Next, root_sequence will execute peg_insertion_check and stop if peg_insertion_check fails. While peg_insertion_check is running, it will re-evaluate its previous actions. If an earlier action fails, it will halt the running action and stop the sequence.

Then, peg_insertion_check will execute ee_y_threshold and peg_insertion in sequence. If ee_y_threshold fails, it will stop. While peg_insertion is running, it will re-evaluate ee_y_threshold. If ee_y_threshold later fails, it will halt peg_insertion and stop the sequence.

Next, peg_insertion will execute goal_condition, search_motion, and the fallback mg_config in order. If goal_condition succeeds, it will stop. Otherwise, it will continue to search_motion and then mg_config. While a later action is running, it will re-evaluate earlier actions. If an earlier action succeeds, it will halt the running action and stop peg_insertion.

Then, goal_condition will execute goal_check and mg_config_goal_and_check in sequence. If goal_check fails, it will stop. While mg_config_goal_and_check is running, it will re-evaluate goal_check. If goal_check later fails, it will halt the parallel action and stop the sequence.

Next, mg_config_goal_and_check will execute mg_sinus, mg_goal1, and goal_check simultaneously. If at least one action succeeds, the parallel action will succeed. If any action fails, the parallel action will fail.

Next, search_motion will execute ee_z_threshold and mg_sinus in sequence. If ee_z_threshold fails, it will stop. While mg_sinus is running, it will re-evaluate ee_z_threshold. If ee_z_threshold later fails, it will halt mg_sinus and stop the sequence.

Next, mg_config will execute mg_sinus and mg_goal1 simultaneously. If at least one action succeeds, the parallel action will succeed. If any action fails, the parallel action will fail.

Next, 2-traverse will execute ee_z_threshold and mg_config in sequence. If ee_z_threshold fails, it will stop. While mg_config is running, it will re-evaluate ee_z_threshold. If ee_z_threshold later fails, it will halt mg_config and stop the sequence.

Next, mg_config will execute mg_sinus and mg_goal2 simultaneously. If at least one action succeeds, the parallel action will succeed. If any action fails, the parallel action will fail.

Finally, the final mg_config will execute mg_sinus and mg_goal1 simultaneously. If at least one action succeeds, the parallel action will succeed. If any action fails, the parallel action will fail.

Parameters: The custom action EEYThreshold will use threshold {y_threshold}, ee_y {ee_y}, and above false. The custom action EEPositionDistance will use threshold 0.05, target_x -0.6, target_y 0.0, target_z 0.64, ee_x {ee_x}, ee_y {ee_y}, and ee_z {ee_z}. The custom action SetMGSin will use mp_ampl 0, mp_freq 0, mg_ampl {mg_ampl}, and mg_freq {mg_freq}. The custom action SetMGGoal will use mp_param_x -0.6, mp_param_y 0.0, mp_param_z 0.73, mg_trans_x {mg_trans_x}, mg_trans_y {mg_trans_y}, and mg_trans_z {mg_trans_z}. The custom action EEZThreshold will use threshold {z_peg_threshold}, ee_z {ee_z}, and above false. The custom action SetMGSin will use mp_ampl {mp_ampl}, mp_freq {mp_freq}, mg_ampl {mg_ampl}, and mg_freq {mg_freq}. The custom action SetMGGoal will use mp_param_x {mp_3_x}, mp_param_y {mp_3_y}, mp_param_z {mp_3_z}, mg_trans_x {mg_trans_x}, mg_trans_y {mg_trans_y}, and mg_trans_z {mg_trans_z}. The custom action EEZThreshold will use threshold {z_threshold}, ee_z {ee_z}, and above true. The custom action SetMGGoal will use mp_param_x {mp_2_x}, mp_param_y {mp_2_y}, mp_param_z {mp_2_z}, mg_trans_x {mg_trans_x}, mg_trans_y {mg_trans_y}, and mg_trans_z {mg_trans_z}. The custom action SetMGGoal will use mp_param_x {mp_1_x}, mp_param_y {mp_1_y}, mp_param_z {mp_1_z}, mg_trans_x {mg_trans_x}, mg_trans_y {mg_trans_y}, and mg_trans_z {mg_trans_z}.

<root main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="BlinkLight">
        <Sequence>
            <SetLightState state="true" />
            <Delay delay_msec="500">
                <SetLightState state="false" />
            </Delay>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>

    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <ForEachMineralSample samples_list="{mineral_samples}" current_sample="{current_sample}">
                <Sequence>
                    <Log message="Moving to next sample..." />
                    <ResetMineralDepositTracker sample="{current_sample}" service_name="/mineral_deposit_tracker/reset" />
                    <GetSamplePose sample="{current_sample}" pose="{sample_pose}" />
                    <PipelineSequence>
                        <RateController hz="1.0">
                            <Sequence>
                                <GoalUpdater input_goal="{sample_pose}" output_goal="{updated_goal}">
                                    <ComputePathToPose goal="{updated_goal}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased" />
                                </GoalUpdater>
                                <TruncatePath distance="1.0" input_path="{path}" output_path="{truncated_path}" />
                            </Sequence>
                        </RateController>
                        <WhileDoElse>
                            <GoalReached goal="{updated_goal}" />
                            <AlwaysSuccess />
                            <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                                <FollowPath path="{truncated_path}" controller_id="FollowPath" />
                            </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                        </WhileDoElse>
                    </PipelineSequence>
                    <Log message="At sample!" />
                    <SubTree ID="BlinkLight" __shared_blackboard="true" />
                </Sequence>
            </ForEachMineralSample>
            <Log message="All samples complete" />
            <SubTree ID="BlinkLight" __shared_blackboard="true" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
mrq:
The mission describes visiting each mineral sample, navigating to its pose, signaling arrival, and signaling completion after all samples have been visited.

First, the root Sequence will execute the actions (ForEachMineralSample, Log, BlinkLight) in order and will stop if any action fails.

Next, the ForEachMineralSample action will process each sample in {mineral_samples} and store the active sample in {current_sample}. For each sample, it will execute the nested Sequence in order and stop that sequence if any action fails.

Next, the nested Sequence will execute the actions (Log, ResetMineralDepositTracker, GetSamplePose, PipelineSequence, Log, BlinkLight) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. The robot will log that it is moving to the next sample. It will run the custom action ResetMineralDepositTracker for the active sample. It will run the custom action GetSamplePose and store the sample pose. It will execute the PipelineSequence in order and stop it if any action fails while advancing when an action is running or has succeeded. It will log that it has arrived at the sample. It will execute the BlinkLight subtree.

Next, the PipelineSequence will execute the actions (RateController, WhileDoElse) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails while advancing when an action is running or has succeeded. The RateController will execute its child at a rate of 1.0 hertz. Its child Sequence will execute the actions (GoalUpdater, TruncatePath) in order and stop if any action fails. The GoalUpdater will update the navigation goal from the sample pose and store the updated goal. It will execute the ROS action ComputePathToPose using the updated goal and store the computed path. The custom action TruncatePath will create a truncated path from the computed path using a distance of 1.0.

Next, the WhileDoElse will execute AlwaysSuccess while GoalReached is true. If GoalReached is false, it will execute KeepRunningUntilFailure. GoalReached will check whether the updated goal has been reached. AlwaysSuccess will succeed. KeepRunningUntilFailure will execute the ROS action FollowPath using the truncated path and the FollowPath controller. If FollowPath succeeds, it will restart FollowPath. If FollowPath fails, it will stop looping.

Next, the BlinkLight subtree will execute the Sequence actions (SetLightState, Delay) in order and stop the sequence if any action fails. It will run the custom action SetLightState with the light state set to true. The Delay will execute its child after the delay timer expires. Its child SetLightState will run with the light state set to false.

Next, after all samples are processed, the root Sequence will run the ROS action Log with the message “All samples complete”. It will then execute the BlinkLight subtree.

Parameters: The custom action ForEachMineralSample will use samples_list={mineral_samples} and current_sample={current_sample}. The ROS action Log will use message="Moving to next sample...". The custom action ResetMineralDepositTracker will use sample={current_sample} and service_name="/mineral_deposit_tracker/reset". The custom action GetSamplePose will use sample={current_sample} and pose={sample_pose}. The custom action RateController will use hz="1.0". The custom action GoalUpdater will use input_goal={sample_pose} and output_goal={updated_goal}. The ROS action ComputePathToPose will use goal={updated_goal}, path={path}, and planner_id="GridBased". The custom action TruncatePath will use distance="1.0", input_path={path}, and output_path={truncated_path}. The custom action GoalReached will use goal={updated_goal}. The ROS action FollowPath will use path={truncated_path} and controller_id="FollowPath". The custom action SetLightState will use state="true" and state="false". The ROS action Log will use message="At sample!" and message="All samples complete".
